scope: Eight current Reporting/Sites completion-unproved targets independently reviewed; five bounded direct decisions and three retained-unproved decisions.

methodology.runtime_boundary: Comparator evidence changes benchmark P3 mapping completion_credit only; Oblivion product, runtime, browser, representative-task, release and overall-audit completion deltas remain zero.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Behavioural evidence only; no source, schema, UI or wording is copied.
methodology.selection_preimage_rule: Packet-order IDs joined by LF with no terminal LF, UTF-8 without BOM.

SNIPE_IT.edition_boundary: Official self-hosted community repository only; hosted services, support arrangements and out-of-tree extensions excluded.

verified_files.loci: supplier relationships, validation and soft deletion

evaluations.requirement: Run an authorised configurable asset report with bounded filters, selected fields and safe export.
evaluations.behavior: The custom asset report filters location, supplier, status, dates and assignment state, selects fields and streams formula-escaped CSV.
evaluations.reason: No Oblivion Site policy, direct-object concealment, exact columns, frontend, accessibility or runtime parity.

evaluations.requirement: Review and export an authorised audit-log report with actor, action, target, time and source context.
evaluations.behavior: Named authorised GET/POST report routes provide filtered activity rows and a controller-owned CSV export with transformed actor/action/item/time/IP data.

evaluations.requirement: Present an authorised catalogue of distinct reports with linked attention counts.
evaluations.behavior: The report controller and index expose distinct report entries and linked attention counts.
